Agreement.description: A cluster every answering panelist backed.

cluster_id.description: None when the panel agreed there is nothing to flag
cluster_id.title: Cluster Id

Agreement.title: Agreement

limit.description: Use only the first N items
limit.title: Limit

Clash.description: A cluster the panel split on. Both sides are shown.
Clash.title: Clash

tool_verified.description: A static-analysis tool confirmed it. Such a cluster is always accepted, and the judge cannot reject it. May have no supporters (the tool found what no model did).
tool_verified.title: Tool Verified

total_weight.description: Sum of the weights of all answering debaters
total_weight.title: Total Weight

vote_accept.description: Weighted vote outcome, before the judge
vote_accept.title: Vote Accept

roles.description: Also run condition 7: the full debate with profile-assigned roles
roles.title: Roles

grounding.description: Static-analysis tools that are installed, e.g. {semgrep: true}
grounding.title: Grounding

api_key_env.description: Name of an environment variable holding the key. Never the key.
api_key_env.title: Api Key Env

base_url.description: Required for openai_compat, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1. digitalocean defaults to https://inference.do-ai.run/v1
base_url.title: Base Url

locality.description: Inferred from the host when omitted; digitalocean is always hosted
locality.title: Locality

installed.description: Ollama only: tag is pulled locally
installed.title: Installed

patch.description: Suggested replacement code, when a panelist gave one
patch.title: Patch

category_roles.description: Optional: pin a category to a role. Otherwise the backend guesses from the name
category_roles.title: Category Roles

corpus.description: Paths relative to the pack directory
corpus.title: Corpus

lower.description: Wilson 95% lower bound of the rate
lower.title: Lower

confidence.description: weight x confidence of panelists who agree with the verdict / total weight
confidence.title: Confidence

tool_verified.description: A static-analysis tool confirmed at least one finding behind this verdict. Confidence still reflects the panel only, so it can be low or 0
tool_verified.title: Tool Verified

category.description: Optional category hint used to pick weights
category.title: Category

escalate.description: always: full debate. auto: best model + best other-family model first; full debate only if they disagree or either is unsure
escalate.title: Escalate

frame.description: Run the framer before round 0. Default: true for escalate=always, false for auto (so an easy input costs exactly 2 model calls)
frame.title: Frame

ground.description: Run a static analyser (Semgrep) over the input. A tool-confirmed finding is accepted regardless of the vote. Review packs only; a no-op if the tool is missing
ground.title: Ground

outsider.description: With 3+ models, the weakest specialist reviews the bare input in round 0 only: no framing, no peers, never revises
outsider.title: Outsider

roles.description: profile: give each model the role it measured best at (review packs only)
roles.title: Roles
